I’ll look up issue #95 and check the project context to work out what needs doing.

Issue [#95](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/issues/95) asks SoftEng to install `asalzburger/unrooted` for documentation plots. I’ll add a reproducible local environment, verify that it can export a plot, and record the setup in the project.
The current upstream revision is `728465d`. Unrooted runs without C++ ROOT, so I’ll install it in a separate Python environment and check both static figure exports and interactive HTML.

Unrooted `0.1.0rc1` is installed, with its source revision and dependencies pinned. I’m checking ROOT-file reading, plotting, and the CLI using synthetic data before recording the installation as complete.

The checks passed: ROOT values and uncertainties round-trip exactly, and the API and CLI export PNG, PDF, SVG, and interactive HTML. The generated figure also looks correct. I’m finishing the setup instructions, retained validation report, project record, and pull request.

The installation and package compatibility checks pass. The project-record tests exposed a fixture limitation: they copy the project’s documents and tools but omit `software/`, where the new deliverables live. I’m updating the fixture to include software source files while excluding local builds and submodules.

The fixture fix is passing the checks that previously failed. The setup instructions and validation report are ready, and project and session validation pass. Once the full test run finishes, I’ll push the branch and open the PR for #95.

All 28 project-record tests now pass, along with the installation, dependency, journal, and token-preview checks. I’m pushing the completed setup and opening the PR; the local environment is ready to use.
The GitHub plugin can read this repository but cannot create the PR. I’ll use the configured GitHub CLI to open it from the pushed branch.
[PR #96](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/96) is open. The local installation is verified; I’m waiting for the hosted Linux smoke check and the repository checks to finish.
The hosted unrooted smoke check passed on Linux too. The token-site check passed; the broader project validation is still running.

Installed and pinned `unrooted 0.1.0rc1` for #95.

ROOT reading and PNG/PDF/SVG/HTML exports pass on macOS and Linux. All 28 local tests pass; broader CI is still running.
